suppress.notes: Spring Boot CVEs applicable only to web/actuator modules. MyJpa-Plus depends only on spring-boot-starter-data-jpa (optional), which does not include the vulnerable web endpoints.
Log4j CVEs — not used directly. MyJpa-Plus uses SLF4J/Logback as provided by Spring Boot. The Log4j API jar is a transitive dependency but the runtime implementation is Logback.
Angus Activation — used by Jakarta Mail for email functionality. MyJpa-Plus is a JPA library and does not send emails.
